packages.section: Part C §7 'F-punk' (steps 1-7) as amended by Part A §A13, §A14 and §A18 (the Punk detail mask: its trigger is met), with the slice gate's locks and its ranked gaps 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 and 13 (docs/milestones/M4-slice-gate.md)
packages.note: Game-boy's Punk pick: Street Punk A, assets/source/concepts/punk_a_denim_vest.jpg (his words, 2026-10-27: "I like Street Punk A, as well."). It is the same concept the smoke Punk stand-in was built from, but the smoke was a single front image-to-model (T1-T3 in the ledger); yours is the full four-view build, so judge it against the concept and against the smoke sheets, and fix the gate's gaps rather than re-designing it. You own tools/pipeline/** (F-player-art owns only tools/pipeline/player_*.py; a change it needs in a shared step comes to you as a request), assets/*/characters/punk/**, assets/source/palette/punk.json, the ASSETS.md 'Characters (Milestone 4) > Punk' rows, the Punk rows of tests/test_art_contract.gd and tests/test_art_punk.gd, and docs/milestones/M4-calls/F-punk.md. Steps: (1) Views of the pick on the mannequin's exact proportions and A-pose (front, then back, left, right, each referencing the concept, the mannequin view of that side and the accepted views; 'flat albedo, no ink outlines, no cel shading'), checked by a views_check (same size, subject height within 3%, feet on one row); regenerate failures. (2) T4 front/left/back to settle which side is left (an asymmetric detail), fix the mapping in tripo.py; T5 the 4-view model (retries change model_seed or a view); T6 only if mushy at 1 m; T7 re-texture only when only the texture is off. (3) T8 rig (v3.0, spec unity) with Tripo's weights (the gate's lock) and the warp landmarks; the A3 landmark residual at 1 cm or less on the rig's own proportions. (4) T9 glove fist: Gemini fist views (knuckles, thumb side, back plate; a dark fingerless glove, bare fingers, an accent strap), multiview detailed geometry, oriented to the fist frame, mirrored, replacing both hands. Gate gap 3: the knuckle face turns toward the lens in straight punches; the glove swatch has value at least about 0.3 so its bands and ink read; the cuff radius comes from the wrist, not the cut's 90th percentile, with no spikes. (5) Borders per the gate (border-protected decimation); at most 15,000 triangles (head, cap and glasses about 3.5k; torso 5k; arms 2.5k; fists 1.5k; legs and shoes 2.5k); remove the authored mesh's folded triangles in decimation or the normal recompute and report the fold count (gap 9). (6) Gap 4: shape the vest's front panel and armholes so the jab wind-up's torso yaw doesn't present a flat slab to the lens; add the visible-stretch test (no edge in an FP-visible cell grows more than 2 cm in the 1 m acts' poses) and only if it fails turn on rig.smooth_iterations, smooth_factor and the named weight clamps (shoulder, collar, waist); switch to auto weights only if that still fails. (7) Gap 7: assert A6 for punk.glb in test_art_punk (torso, legs and head at least 95% inside hurtbox + 6 cm) and the art-drawn lens rules (a held victim at least 0.25 m from the lens through grab, 3 knees and throw; the jab-cross at 0.95 m with no in-view vertex nearer than 5 cm); keep the cap and head inside the head sphere + 5 cm; a per-region girth clamp in blender_fit only if A6 misses. (8) Palette: a lens swatch with marks false and thinner marks on the cap (they shared punk_yellow and took clothes-density blood); the jeans their own slot if the pick has them (gap 13). (9) A18: the 1k ink-only Punk detail mask on UV2, baked from the dense texture (mouth, pocket flaps, buttons, stitching, laces, tape edges; never shading), wired so the toon shader multiplies toward ink by it; list it for the lead's README departures section (it departs from SPEC §10's 'shared atlas only' for enemies). (10) Export over assets/export/characters/punk/punk.glb (same path; punk_art.tres and street_punk.tscn unchanged); re-run run.py --check; re-record L0-bench's C1-C13, P3-early's c14 and P3-flash's ff1-ff3 on it (one act per process) and compare with the smoke Punk's sheets. Done: the contract green, the A-rows asserted for punk.glb, and the 1 m sheets beside the concept read as the pick (say honestly whether they do).

packages.note: Game-boy's hero pick: Hero C, assets/source/concepts/hero_c_martial.jpg (his words, 2026-10-27: "Eventually, I'll want to allow for selecting from a menu of hero options, but for this demo, let's go with Hero C."). No mix and match: the whole hero is concept C. The hero menu is a later milestone, not this package, but keep everything hero-specific in files (the GLB, player.json, player_detail.png, named by player_art.tres) so a second hero is another set of files, not a code change; note anything that would block that in your calls file. You own assets/source/characters/player/**, assets/export/characters/player/** (player.glb and player_detail.png), assets/source/palette/player.json, tools/pipeline/player_*.py (a change to a shared step goes to F-punk as a request), the ASSETS.md 'Characters (Milestone 4) > Player' rows, and docs/milestones/M4-calls/F-player-art.md. A full generated body, not a hybrid: the KO view shows the whole lying body and the hidden upper body casts the shadows the player sees. At most 30,000 triangles, two thirds FP-visible (fists 2x3k, forearms 2x1.5k, belly and belt 1.5k, legs 2x2k, shoes 2x2k). Steps: (1) Views of the hero pick on the mannequin (mix and match: separate references per part, as his words say); T11 body; T12 rig (Tripo weights, the A-pose route, as the gate locked). (2) T13 the wrapped fist (wraps across the knuckles and wrist, a dark fingerless-glove plate, skin fingers, per ARCHITECTURE 'Hands') from the sheet's hand callouts, detailed geometry, up to 3 tries: the most-seen asset in the game. T14 a shoe only if the body's fail the first-person look-down. (3) split_fp with inward caps: Body and Body__fp_hidden (Chest and above, both shoulders and the shoulder half of each upper arm), and optionally a third mesh Body__fp_torso (Spine and Hips, the belly and belt) so fp_knockdown_hide_torso hides only the belly (F-player-int's request); the 1k detail mask on UV2 (R = ink: wrap edges, glove stitching, shoe seams, trouser folds) as player_detail.png. (4) Export to assets/export/characters/player/player.glb: F-player-int's player_art.tres names that path in metadata, so the player wears it with no code edit (ResourceLoader.exists() turns it on). Then run tests/test_art_player.gd on it (A9 at the plan's bars against FPView's proxies and against the proxies' own meshes, the watertight mesh with the split's caps closed, the hold, the KO view, the knockdown) and the full suite, and record 'Look: my arms and legs' (pa1), 'Look: my knockdown' (pa2) and F-look's 'Look: tune own hull' (T8; the box hull read 4.2-4.7 px at the guard on the primitives) on it. Done: first-person sheets show the wraps, glove plate, sleeves or trousers and shoes crisp at 0.3-0.6 m, no hollow cut, outlines not heavy, the suite green (say honestly how they read).
